notes.title: NetCode + Caffeine
notes.content:
Hey all, apologies for the huge delay in updating the game. This update required a rework to the entire combat system and player movement system, as well as a lot of other backend changes. We hope it's been worth the wait!

[b]What's new?[/b]
[list]
[*] Shifted movement mode to a far more performant network protocol (This was the main reason for this update's delayed release.)
[*] Fixed jungle map lag
[*] Added intro skip option in settings
[*] Upgraded from UE4.25 to UE4.27
[*] Fixed a lot of server-side and client-side crashes
[*] Fixed ghost servers
[*] Added throne room, sand pit and balcony map (Still undergoing internal testing, but will be enabled soon)
[*] Kicking a player from a lobby now properly prevents them from rejoining, even with a VPN
[*] Fixed an issue where rotating while sprinting would stop the sprint
[*] Many, many more internal fixes to make content additions a lot more simple and bug-free in the future
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapons do not persist in player's hands when changing map. Make sure to holster them!
[*] Occasional movement jitter due to the new network protocol.
[*] Occasionally, the regrow state of a weapon becomes desynced for a short period of time, which may allow players with a seemingly broken blade to still hit you.
[/list]

We hope you're as excited as us for the future of Gurrah. We have lots of new content in the works and hope you'll enjoy it when we add it to the game officially!

Thanks again for your patience

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6

Patch/update time! Big change here and it may take you 15 minutes to adapt and get used to it. Patch 1.0.6:

[b][h2]General:[/h2][/b]

notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
We’re excited to bring you all the patch notes for the first update of May! We’ve been working on fixes for the bugs you’ve reported and work is being done to balance and refine the game’s mechanics. Here are the patch notes for 1.0.5:

[b][h2]Patches[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Small modifications under the hood of scoreboards
[*] Additional swing and latency smoothing
[*] Stopped servers shutting down in the middle of the night
[*] Spectator character tweaks
[*] Connection timeout timers have been doubled
[*] Moving throwing range targets don’t get out of sync any more
[*] Server browser menu will now timeout for 5 seconds after server connection failure
[*] Kick player should now be working
[*] Fixed a CTF bug where the flag wouldn’t get returned if picked up by a team member
[/list]

[b][h2]Changes[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Monster Arena is now playable in multiplayer
[*] In Monster Arena, every 5 waves has a respawn, heal and 60 second break
[*] Ping now displays for servers
[*] 2h Swords head damage lowered
[*] 1h Sword weapon damage lowered
[*] 1h Axe slash damage increased
[*] Battle Axe damage increased
[*] Updated battle axe collision boxes
[*] 2h weapons harden can now be activated with a single trigger
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for Hotfix 1.0.4
notes.content:
It’s been a while since we pushed our last patch update. We’ve been working on fixing a lot of the major bugs and we thank you all for your patience! This patch should fix a lot of the unexpected crashes and other various issues. Here are the notes for patch 1.0.4:

[h2][b]Patches[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with the flag not returning after being picked up by a member of the owning team
[*] Fixed 7 separate crashes
[*] Repaired damage tint
[*] Fixed a bug where a player could strike both the head and body in the same frame
[*] Fixed an issue with the flag capture that caused the flag to permanently disappear
[*] Fixed issues with the flag’s physics
[*] Players can no longer pick up their own team’s flag from their own base
[*] Disabled the fish collision in the marketplace
[*] Lobbies can now have odd numbers
[*] Voice chat now works on Europe and Asia servers
[/list]

[h2][b]Changes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced dagger head strike damage
[*] Reduced the damage of the battle axe
[*] Increased the flag’s weight so the player is slower when carrying it
[*] The flag will now always stand up straight
[*] Players are no longer able to spawn with dual two handed weapons
[*] Added correct player spawns and weapon spawns to marketplace
[*] When holding a two handed weapon with one hand, your other weapons will be set as inactive.
[/list]

notes.title: Wednesday Update Log
notes.content:
Hi Gladiators, it’s time for another [b]Wednesday update log![/b] The last few weeks have been primarily focused on fixing IK, replication, and various other bugs in preparation for our launch. Fortunately we have made major progress during this time and we can't wait for everyone to get in and play!


[b]Since Last week we:[/b]

[list]
[*] Implemented in game voice chat
[*] Implemented prettier VFX for Aqueduct and Locker room
[*] Further refined replication for a smoother swordplay experience
[*] Implemented fancy Victory and Defeat screen
[*] Made blocking/hardening quicker
[*] Can lock both hands when using two handed weapons
[*] Hands now properly rotate when switching angles on two handed weapons
[*] Aqueduct now works for all game modes except CTF
[*] Forcepull is now tighter and should feel more natural.
[*] Added drone AI
[*] Slight Weapon Balancing
[/list]




[b]
Our primary focuses for the upcoming update are:[/b]

[list]
[*] Continue to refine replication
[*] Refine Replication for thrown items
[*] Correct skeleton positions
[*] Fix IK issues
[*] Implementing positional voice chat
[*] Refine Marketplace
[*] 
[/list]


We’d like to thank you for your patience and participation while we finish up and get ready for early access launch!

[b]-Devster[/b]

notes.title: Friday Update #3
notes.content:
Hi, Gurrites! It's time for another [b]Friday update log[/b]! The past couple of weeks we've been focusing our efforts on implementing an in-game voice chat system and creating some game modes ready for our release! We also settled on a much more reliable server host and are working on implementing the ability for anyone to start a server at any time and have the server be hosted on Devster networking!

[b]Since last week, we:[/b]
[list]
[*] Implemented in game voice chat
[*] Further improved networking lag, specifically on thrown weapons
[*] Implemented Discord Rich Presence
[*] Made good progress on the CTF gamemode by adding grabable flags and capture zones
[/list]

Once again, we'd like to take the time to thank you for your patience and dedication while we develop Gurrah!

Happy Holidays. We wish you all a happy new year!
[b]-Devster[/b]

notes.title: Friday Update #2
notes.content:
[b]Friday Update Log #2[/b]

Hey Gurrites! Apologies for the inconsistent updates. Since our last update log, we've been been focusing on dedicated servers for the game and P2P connections. We've managed to reduce latency and will continue to do so as a high priority moving forward. 
Besides that, we've been constantly pushing updates to the game and cleaning everything up ready to make some main game modes. We've implemented a working server browser, we've updated some sounds and we've been doing a whole lotta polishing!

We've also done some work on weapon balancing and would love for you to express your opinions on this as well as any other opinions on the game whether you've played the game or not. 

Finally, we're working on creating a public, coherent roadmap detailing our current and future plans for the game's development community. We hope this will allow you to express your opinion on an upcoming feature or idea before it's implemented.

[b]Happy Slashing,
Devster[/b]
